lines.zh: 壳裂了，我照样往前爬。
lines.en: My shell is cracked, and I still crawl on.

lines.zh: 螺壳磨着礁石，一路掉碎屑。
lines.en: My spiral shell grinds the reef, shedding crumbs the whole way.

lines.zh: 我拖着感染的软足走过潮池。
lines.en: I drag infected flesh-foot through the tide pool.

lines.zh: 壳里的水晃荡，替我数着步子。
lines.en: Water sloshes in my shell and counts my steps.

lines.zh: 每一步都挤出一小滩浑水。
lines.en: Every step squeezes out a little cloudy puddle.

lines.zh: 我的壳比身体重，走得慢。
lines.en: My shell outweighs my body, so I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 沙里留下螺旋形的湿印。
lines.en: A spiral wet print stays behind me in the sand.

lines.zh: 别走太快，我的壳跟不上。
lines.en: Do not walk so fast; my shell cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 我沿着海底的裂缝往上爬。
lines.en: I climb along a crack in the seabed, upward.

lines.zh: 碎壳掉了一路，捡不回来。
lines.en: Shell fragments fall all along the way, beyond gathering.

lines.zh: 软足在盐里泡得发白。
lines.en: My soft foot has soaked pale in the salt.

lines.zh: 我用壳撞开挡路的珊瑚。
lines.en: I butt the coral aside with my shell.

lines.zh: 壳口朝上，等潮水来。
lines.en: Shell mouth up, I wait for the tide.

lines.zh: 我听见壳里有东西在敲。
lines.en: I hear something knocking inside my shell.

lines.zh: 感染在壳内慢慢转圈。
lines.en: The infection circles slowly inside the shell.

lines.zh: 一只寄居蟹敲我的壳，我懒得理。
lines.en: A hermit crab taps my shell; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把软足缩回去，装成空壳。
lines.en: I pull my foot in and pretend to be empty.

lines.zh: 海藻缠住壳顶，我不去扯。
lines.en: Seaweed wraps my crown, and I leave it there.

lines.zh: 泡泡从壳缝里冒出来，又破掉。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from my shell seam and pop.

lines.zh: 我数着潮汐，数到一半忘了。
lines.en: I count the tides and lose the number halfway.

lines.zh: 壳片在阳光下发着病态的光。
lines.en: My shell shard shines with a sickly light in the sun.

lines.zh: 有只鱼在舔我壳上的盐。
lines.en: A fish is licking salt off my shell.

lines.zh: 你用两根手指就能捏碎我。
lines.en: Two fingers of yours could crush me.

lines.zh: 我看见你的靴子，比我的壳干净。
lines.en: I see your boots, cleaner than my shell.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，是想捡我的壳片吗。
lines.en: You crouch down; are you after my shell shards?

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的潮池。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my whole tide pool.

lines.zh: 别用手碰壳口，里面还活着。
lines.en: Do not touch my shell mouth; something lives in there.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子只能弯这么多。
lines.en: I look up at you; my neck bends only this far.

lines.zh: 你身上有海腥味，像我以前的同伴。
lines.en: You smell of the sea, like the kin I had.

lines.zh: 我认得那种眼神，你在估价。
lines.en: I know that look; you are pricing me.

lines.zh: 你的护甲反光，晃得我缩了一下。
lines.en: Your armor flashes and makes me flinch.

lines.zh: 你看我这么久，是没见过的品种吗。
lines.en: Staring this long, have you never seen my kind?

lines.zh: 壳碎了，露出里面感染的内脏。
lines.en: The shell breaks and shows infected innards.

lines.zh: 我疼，却还是往你那边爬。
lines.en: I hurt, and I still crawl toward you.

lines.zh: 裂缝里渗出浑浊的液体。
lines.en: Cloudy fluid seeps from the crack.

lines.zh: 你砍中的是我换壳的旧伤。
lines.en: You struck the old wound from my last molt.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起被感染那天。
lines.en: This takes me back to the day I was infected.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，你又敲了一下。
lines.en: I shrink into my shell and you knock again.

lines.zh: 我的软足被削掉一截，还会长。
lines.en: A piece of my foot is cut away; it will regrow.

lines.zh: 壳片落进沙里，我不去捡。
lines.en: Shards drop into the sand and I do not gather them.

lines.zh: 你在打一具已经死过的东西。
lines.en: You are beating something that already died.

lines.zh: 我怕火，怕得比疼更甚。
lines.en: I fear fire more than I fear pain.

lines.zh: 是盐吗，我闻到盐了。
lines.en: Is that salt? I smell salt.

lines.zh: 你手里那点湿意，能分我一口吗。
lines.en: That dampness in your hand, may I have a sip?

lines.zh: 我不吃，但我想要你手上的水。
lines.en: I do not eat, but I want the water on your hands.

lines.zh: 海带的味道，从你背包里漏出来。
lines.en: Kelp smell is leaking from your pack.

lines.zh: 把湿海绵放下，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Set the wet sponge down and I will follow.

lines.zh: 我壳里空了半年，给我点水。
lines.en: My shell has been dry for half a year; give me water.

lines.zh: 你身上有潮气，我跟着潮气走。
lines.en: You carry damp air; I follow the damp air.

lines.zh: 一块湿石头就够我爬半天。
lines.en: One wet stone is enough to keep me crawling for hours.

lines.zh: 我闻到你鞋底的泥，是海边的。
lines.en: The mud on your soles smells of the shore.

lines.zh: 别逗我，我爬得慢，追不上。
lines.en: Do not tease me; I crawl too slowly to chase.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我掉一块壳。
lines.en: One bump and a piece of my shell falls off.

lines.zh: 我的壳很硬，你的膝盖会疼。
lines.en: My shell is hard; your knee will hurt.

lines.zh: 让让，我转不了这么急的弯。
lines.en: Step aside; I cannot turn that sharply.

lines.zh: 你踩到我了，软足黏在你鞋上。
lines.en: You stepped on me; my foot sticks to your boot.

lines.zh: 别推，壳里的水会洒。
lines.en: Do not push; the water in my shell will spill.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁都没动。
lines.en: We collide and neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 我的壳卡在你盾牌边上了。
lines.en: My shell is wedged against your shield rim.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我壳口的朝向全乱了。
lines.en: That impact scrambled which way my shell mouth points.

lines.zh: 你退后，我挪得比你想的慢。
lines.en: Back off; I shift slower than you think.

lines.zh: 碎壳扎到你了吗，我不是故意的。
lines.en: Did the shards cut you? It was not intended.

lines.zh: 我的同类都感染了，还谈什么。
lines.en: My kin are all infected; what is there to talk about?

lines.zh: 壳对壳，我们只是互相靠着。
lines.en: Shell against shell, we only lean on each other.

lines.zh: 潮水会带走卵，我不守着。
lines.en: The tide carries the eggs away; I do not guard them.

lines.zh: 我的壳纹和它的一模一样。
lines.en: Its shell pattern is identical to mine.

lines.zh: 繁殖对我这具身体太奢侈。
lines.en: Breeding is a luxury this body cannot afford.

lines.zh: 等退潮，我们在石缝里碰头。
lines.en: At low tide we meet in the rock crevice.

lines.zh: 它用触角碰我的壳口，就算答应了。
lines.en: It touches my shell mouth with an antenna, and that is a yes.

lines.zh: 感染后我们照样贴在一起。
lines.en: Even infected, we still press close together.

lines.zh: 我们不产卵，只把壳留给海浪。
lines.en: We lay no eggs; we leave our shells to the surf.

lines.zh: 别围观，黏在一起是私事。
lines.en: Do not watch; sticking together is private.

lines.zh: 你捡起我的壳片，就带走吧。
lines.en: You picked up my shard; take it with you.

lines.zh: 那块碎片还会动，别放进包里。
lines.en: That fragment still moves; do not put it in your bag.

lines.zh: 我掉的东西不值钱，但咸。
lines.en: What I drop is worthless, but salty.

lines.zh: 捡吧，我身上还会再掉。
lines.en: Take it; more will fall off me soon.

lines.zh: 你把壳片举到光下，看那道裂纹。
lines.en: You hold the shard to the light and study its crack.

lines.zh: 这片壳是我去年换下来的。
lines.en: This shell piece is the one I shed last year.

lines.zh: 别捡壳口那圈，还是软的。
lines.en: Do not take the ring by my mouth; it is still soft.

lines.zh: 你手里已经有三片了。
lines.en: You already have three pieces in your hand.

lines.zh: 壳片会割手，我的错。
lines.en: The shard cuts hands; that is my fault.

lines.zh: 你捡走的是我的一部分。
lines.en: What you carry off is part of me.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我的壳片，就是你。
lines.en: You crushed my shard, so it is you.

lines.zh: 活人的味道，我的软足收紧了。
lines.en: The smell of the living; my foot tightens.

lines.zh: 我不追快的，只追停下来的。
lines.en: I do not chase the fast, only those who stop.

lines.zh: 你背对我，那一刻我决定了。
lines.en: You turned your back, and I decided then.

lines.zh: 感染的冲动涌上来，我盯住你。
lines.en: The infected urge rises and I fix on you.

lines.zh: 你离潮池太远，跑不掉了。
lines.en: You are too far from the pool to escape.

lines.zh: 我的壳磨着地，声音在靠近。
lines.en: My shell grinds the ground; the sound comes closer.

lines.zh: 你身上的盐少，我闻得出。
lines.en: You carry little salt; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我挑最慢的那个，就是你。
lines.en: I pick the slowest one, and that is you.

lines.zh: 恶心的饥饿醒了，它要你。
lines.en: The sick hunger wakes, and it wants you.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，我记下了。
lines.en: That torch in your hand is noted.

lines.zh: 我贴地爬，你看不到影子。
lines.en: I crawl low; you will not see my shadow.

lines.zh: 目标锁定，我的软足开始分泌。
lines.en: Target fixed; my foot begins to secrete.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我的壳就响一下。
lines.en: You move once, my shell answers once.

lines.zh: 你蹲下捡壳片，那就别站起来了。
lines.en: You crouch for shell shards. Stay down.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边绕，等一个破绽。
lines.en: I circle your ankles, waiting for a gap.

lines.zh: 壳片在沙上刮出声音，你听见了。
lines.en: Shell shards scrape the sand; you hear it.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我进一步，很公平。
lines.en: Each step you yield, I take; that is fair.

lines.zh: 我瞄准的是你的脚踝。
lines.en: My aim is your ankle.

lines.zh: 感染的黏液能黏住你的鞋。
lines.en: The infected slime will glue your boot down.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我就等盾放下。
lines.en: Raise your shield; I wait until it drops.

lines.zh: 我爬得慢，但我不需要睡觉。
lines.en: I crawl slowly, but I never need sleep.

lines.zh: 你看向别处了，很好。
lines.en: You looked away; good.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，让你的箭射空。
lines.en: I hug the ground so your arrows miss.

lines.zh: 潮水在涨，你的退路在缩。
lines.en: The tide is rising and your retreat is shrinking.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊会暴露我的位置。
lines.en: I will not call out; noise gives away my place.

lines.zh: 再走近一点，我够得到你。
lines.en: A pace nearer and my foot can touch your ankle.

lines.zh: 你用剑砍壳，剑会滑。
lines.en: Strike my shell with a sword and the blade slides.

lines.zh: 我一直在数你的步子。
lines.en: I have been counting your steps all along.

lines.zh: 我绕到你的影子边缘，不进去。
lines.en: I circle the edge of your shadow and stay out.

lines.zh: 你换脚站，我跟着挪半格。
lines.en: You shift your weight. I shift half a block.

lines.zh: 我趴进泥里，只留壳顶露着。
lines.en: I sink into the silt, only my shell showing.

lines.zh: 你的灯照到哪，我就退到哪。
lines.en: Where your lamp reaches, I withdraw.

lines.zh: 软足一拍，黏液糊上你的腿。
lines.en: My foot slaps and slime plasters your leg.

lines.zh: 我用壳棱撞你的胫骨。
lines.en: I drive my shell ridge into your shin.

lines.zh: 感染的牙很小，但很密。
lines.en: Infected teeth are small, but they are dense.

lines.zh: 这一口咬下去，你会发烧。
lines.en: One bite like this and you will run a fever.

lines.zh: 我把你绊倒，然后压上去。
lines.en: I trip you and then press down.

lines.zh: 壳口的齿刮过你的护甲缝。
lines.en: Teeth at my shell mouth rake your armor seam.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，黏液就渗进去了。
lines.en: One shove, and the slime seeps inside.

lines.zh: 你的血混进我的浑水里。
lines.en: Your blood mixes into my cloudy water.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，像咬住礁石。
lines.en: I bite and hold, the way I hold a reef.

lines.zh: 疼吗，我感染时更疼。
lines.en: Does it hurt? My infection hurt worse.

lines.zh: 我用整个壳的重量砸下去。
lines.en: I bring the full weight of my shell down.

lines.zh: 你砍我，我就把碎壳踢向你眼睛。
lines.en: Cut me and I kick shards at your eyes.

lines.zh: 我分泌的黏液会麻你的手。
lines.en: The slime I secrete will numb your hand.

lines.zh: 这一击之后，我会退开等潮。
lines.en: After this blow I retreat and wait for the tide.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的小腿咬，黏液先渗。
lines.en: I bite at your calf. The slime soaks in first.

lines.zh: 壳沿磕在你膝盖上，很钝。
lines.en: My shell rim knocks your knee. A dull hit.

lines.zh: 我从一层死水里爬上来了。
lines.en: I crawled up out of a sheet of dead water.

lines.zh: 壳是新的，感染已经旧了。
lines.en: The shell is new; the infection is old.

lines.zh: 潮池干涸，我只能上岸。
lines.en: My pool dried, so I had to come ashore.

lines.zh: 谁把感染的螺扔进了这片海。
lines.en: Someone threw an infected snail into this sea.

lines.zh: 我在礁石背面睁开了眼柄。
lines.en: I opened my eyestalks behind a rock.

lines.zh: 这具壳不是我选的，但我住下了。
lines.en: I did not choose this shell, but I moved in.

lines.zh: 海水太暖，感染就醒了。
lines.en: The water grew warm, and the infection woke.

lines.zh: 我闻见活人的味道，刚孵化就会闻。
lines.en: I smell the living; I could smell it from hatching.

lines.zh: 我顶着满壳的藤壶站起来。
lines.en: I rise with a shell full of barnacles.

lines.zh: 沙下的卵裂开，我钻了出来。
lines.en: The egg under the sand split and I crawled out.

lines.zh: 这地方没有潮汐，我也会爬。
lines.en: There is no tide here, and I still crawl.

lines.zh: 我的同类在附近，它们的壳更破。
lines.en: My kin are near, and their shells are worse.

lines.zh: 我带着上一只螺的记忆上岸。
lines.en: I come ashore carrying the last snail's memory.

lines.zh: 别问我从哪片海来，我忘了。
lines.en: Do not ask which sea I came from; I forgot.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的壳像锅一样响。
lines.en: Fire licks me and my shell rings like a pot.

lines.zh: 摔下来，壳里的水全洒了。
lines.en: I fell, and all the water in my shell spilled.

lines.zh: 我本该在水里，这具身体却不会呼吸。
lines.en: I belong in water, yet this body cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，壳口朝下。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, shell mouth down.

lines.zh: 箭钉在壳上，像多了一根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell like one more spine.

lines.zh: 魔法穿过壳，直接烧里面的我。
lines.en: Magic passes through the shell and burns the me inside.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我开始啃自己的壳。
lines.en: Starving long enough, I begin to gnaw my own shell.

lines.zh: 雷打过我的壳，纹路更亮了。
lines.en: Lightning struck my shell and the ridges shine brighter.

lines.zh: 掉下去时，壳比我先碎。
lines.en: Falling, my shell shatters before I do.
